<!--
Thanks for contributing! Please use a Conventional Commit style PR title,
e.g. "fix: clamp the Away target" or "feat: add a setback write helper".
This drives release-please's automated changelog and versioning.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? Link related issues, e.g. "Closes #7". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy` passes — the config is `strict`
- [ ] `pytest` passes and new/changed behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] I have updated the README / docstrings / `docs/` where relevant

## Behaviour changes worth calling out

<!--
Anything a consumer has to react to: a changed default, a new exception, a
deprecation, or a wire-format change (see docs/decompiled-api-reference.md).
Please cite where the behaviour was observed — the official app, your own
hardware, or a decompiled method — since that is what distinguishes a fix from a
guess. Do not commit decompiled Dimplex source, proprietary assets, APK binaries
or credentials.
-->
